clara: Heads-up from support: customers are confused when the Y axis silently changes units and when spikes are clipped. Can we propose an accessible UX for both?

noah: Quick proposal: show a tiny persistent unit badge next to the y-axis title (e.g., "Latency (auto)"). Clicking it opens a compact picker: Auto | ms | s | raw. When Auto flips units, show a subtle toast: "Units: ms (auto)".

oscar: On clipping: instead of silently flattening, render a small chevron marker at the clip boundary with a dashed guide. The chevron has a tooltip: "12 values > 10s clipped" and is keyboard-focusable. Click opens a modal with examples.

judy: Tooltip copy tweak: change the line from "p95: 1234567" to "p95 latency  1.23 s
raw: 1234567 µs". Raw should be monospace and include a copy icon. Keyboard copy should copy the raw value.

clara: Also add a small "smoothed" pill in the tooltip header when smoothing is on: "smoothed • window=3m". Avoid mixing that into the main metric row.

oscar: Implementation note: draw chevron/guide in a separate SVG layer (.chart-decoration) so toggling doesn't repaint the main canvas. CSS: `.chart-decoration { pointer-events: auto } .chev:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--focus) }`.

judy: Accessibility list (short): 1) unit picker reachable via keyboard + announce unit change via aria-live; 2) chevron role=button + aria-haspopup=dialog; 3) tooltip role=dialog when focused and include aria-describedby for raw value; 4) legend collapsed -> combobox with arrow nav.

a11y-bot: Added checklist items: #A11Y-210 unit picker, #A11Y-211 clip chevron, #A11Y-212 tooltip semantics.

noah: I'll mock the unit badge + picker and the chevron in Figma and add keyboard flows. Target: early next week.

clara: Thanks all 496 I'll summarize copy options and link the mocks when ready.
